About this item

  • The multi-position seat is extra padded for your comfort & support during sessions and can be adjusted to suit different users. Durable upholstery made to last. Workout stations include: high & low pulley, dual-action chest station (chest press and pec-deck), adjustable preacher pad, one-piece butterfly press and more!
  • Solid Construction: A sturdy steel frame keeps you safe while exercising. All-in-one machine will fit in your garage or side of your living room. A compact gym station which is ideal for home use. Maximise muscle activation – ergonomically designed with comfort in mind.
  • The compact multi gym for strength training at home: complete, comfortable, and versatile. Excellent home training station for full body workout.
  • Perform a wide variety of efficient and challenging exercises to strengthen and tone your entire body. Legs, arms, chest, shoulders and more: develop your potential with targeted muscle training.
  • Includes 72KG or 100KG weight stack that can be customised based on skill level. Dimensions: Length=186cm, Width=108cm, Height=205cm. Product Weight: 158KG. Weight stack: 72KG or 100KG. Micro cable adjustment; Double pulley system

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Great product and great company to deal with
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 30 September 2026
    Size Name: Multi Gym with 72KG Weight Stack
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    We ordered the STRONGWAY MULTI GYM WITH WEIGHTS - MULTIFUNCTION HOME GYM MACHINE. The delivery service was excellent and they communicated really well on delivery times etc.

    We had a budget and so we were not expecting great things, how wrong we were! This is a solid piece of kit and the quality is great. We are so pleased with it. We are older and want to keep our muscle strength up and we have found it easy to find our way around the machine.

    We had a small issue and the customer service was very good. Manish was extremely helpful. You need to communicate via chat in their website but they respond very quickly.

    I’m not saying this was easy to put together, it took us a day but it was so worth it! Strongway had a video that really helped us out.

    Overall a good company to deal with and a great product!
